vision: A playful, cat-themed mobile habit tracker that makes building good habits fun through gamification, time-aware suggestions, and visual streak tracking

target_audience.primary: Individual consumers seeking to build and maintain positive habits through gamification and visual tracking
secondary: Productivity enthusiasts who want cross-platform habit tracking
Users who respond well to playful/gamified interfaces (cat theme)
People who need gentle accountability and motivational support
Users who prefer mobile-first experiences with web fallback

phases.name: Foundation & Polish
phases.description: Complete MVP gaps, fix technical debt, and strengthen core experience. Quick wins that address immediate user needs and competitor weaknesses.

milestones.title: Core Stability
milestones.description: All core features work reliably - habits can be reordered, paused, and archived without bugs

milestones.title: User Data Ownership
milestones.description: Users can export their data and trust their habits are safe

milestones.title: Motivation Enhancement
milestones.description: Users feel supported when they miss days with recovery messaging

phases.name: User Experience Enhancement
phases.description: Add features that directly address competitor pain points and user-requested improvements. Focus on friction reduction and delight.

milestones.title: Quick Access
milestones.description: Users can complete habits without opening the full app via widgets

milestones.title: Offline Resilience
milestones.description: App works offline and syncs when connected - no data loss anxiety

milestones.title: Flexible Tracking
milestones.description: Users can track habits with complex schedules and multiple daily completions

phases.name: Social & Sharing
phases.description: Add accountability and community features that competitors have abandoned or implemented poorly. Build trust through transparency.

milestones.title: Share & Celebrate
milestones.description: Users can share achievements and invite friends to join their habit journey

milestones.title: Accountability Partners
milestones.description: Users can connect with friends for mutual accountability

milestones.title: Premium Value
milestones.description: Sustainable monetization that respects users (unlike competitors)

phases.name: Advanced & Future
phases.description: Wearable integration, AI enhancements, and advanced features for power users. Build platform stickiness.

milestones.title: Wearable Integration
milestones.description: Complete habits from Apple Watch or Wear OS

milestones.title: Smart Insights
milestones.description: AI provides personalized insights and recommendations

milestones.title: Ecosystem Integration
milestones.description: Connect with health and productivity apps

features.title: Implement Habit Reordering
features.description: Complete the reorderHabits mutation in convex/habits.ts to enable drag-and-drop habit reordering. The UI already supports this but the backend mutation is missing.
features.rationale: Critical functionality gap identified in technical debt. Users expect to organize their habits in their preferred order. This is a quick win since UI is already built.
acceptance_criteria: Users can drag and drop habits to reorder them on the main screen
New order persists across app restarts
Reorder works across different habit categories
Optimistic updates provide instant feedback
user_stories: As a user, I want to reorder my habits so that I see my most important habits first
As a user, I want my habit order to be saved so I don't have to reorganize every time

features.title: Habit Pause & Resume
features.description: Allow users to temporarily pause habits without breaking streaks or losing data. Paused habits are hidden from daily view but preserved in history.
features.rationale: Users need flexibility during vacations, illness, or life changes. Habitica punishes users for breaks, causing frustration. This supports recovery from setbacks - a major market gap.
acceptance_criteria: Users can pause any active habit from the habit detail screen
Paused habits are not shown in daily view but appear in a 'Paused' section
Streak is preserved during pause period (not counted as missed days)
Users can resume habits at any time
Pause history is tracked (when paused, when resumed)
user_stories: As a user going on vacation, I want to pause my workout habit so my streak isn't broken
As a user recovering from illness, I want to pause habits temporarily without losing my progress

features.title: Data Export & Backup
features.description: Allow users to export their habit data in common formats (JSON, CSV) for backup or switching apps. Include completions, streaks, notes, and analytics.
features.rationale: Addresses the data safety concern that plagues Loop Habit Tracker (Android only, local storage only). Builds trust by giving users ownership of their data. Differentiates from competitors with lock-in strategies.
acceptance_criteria: Users can export all habit data as JSON file
Users can export completion history as CSV
Export includes: habits, completions, notes, streaks, categories
Export can be triggered from settings screen
File can be shared via system share sheet
user_stories: As a user, I want to export my habit data so I have a backup in case something goes wrong
As a user, I want to download my data so I can analyze it in a spreadsheet

features.title: Code Cleanup & Refactoring
features.description: Refactor large components (HabitDetailScreen at 113KB), remove duplicate files (affirmations 2.ts, habits.ts.simple), and clean up technical debt.
features.rationale: Technical debt slows feature development and increases bug risk. The large HabitDetailScreen makes maintenance difficult. Clean code enables faster iteration.
acceptance_criteria: HabitDetailScreen split into smaller, focused components (<500 lines each)
Duplicate files removed or consolidated
All TODO comments addressed or converted to tracked issues
No regression in existing functionality
user_stories: As a developer, I want clean organized code so I can add features faster
As a developer, I want no duplicate files so I know which code is authoritative

features.title: Streak Recovery & Forgiveness
features.description: Allow users to 'forgive' missed days under certain circumstances (e.g., once per month free, or with explanation). Prevent streak loss from being devastating.
features.rationale: Habitica and Streaks punish users harshly for missed days, leading to abandonment. Research shows forgiving systems have better retention. The cat theme can make forgiveness feel supportive rather than like cheating.
acceptance_criteria: Users get 1 free 'forgiveness' per habit per month
Forgiveness retroactively marks a missed day as completed
Cat character provides encouraging message when forgiveness is used
Forgiveness count resets monthly
Clear UI indicates forgiveness is available
user_stories: As a user who missed a day due to emergency, I want to recover my streak so I stay motivated
As a user, I want the app to be forgiving so I don't feel punished for being human

features.title: Enhanced Comeback Messaging
features.description: When users return after missing days, provide personalized cat-themed messages that acknowledge the gap and encourage continuation rather than focusing on failure.
features.rationale: Market gap: apps punish rather than encourage recovery. Cat personality can provide emotional support. This is a key differentiator from austere apps like Streaks and Loop.
acceptance_criteria: System detects when user returns after 2+ day absence
Cat character displays personalized welcome-back message
Messages vary based on absence length (2 days vs 2 weeks)
Focus on future progress, not past failure
At least 20 unique comeback message variants
user_stories: As a user returning after a break, I want to feel welcomed back so I'm motivated to continue
As a user, I want the cat to be understanding so I don't feel guilty about missing days

features.title: Interactive Home Screen Widgets
features.description: Create iOS and Android widgets that display today's habits and allow direct completion without opening the app. Support multiple widget sizes.
features.rationale: Streaks has view-only widgets, users want interactive ones. Loop has widget issues. This reduces friction for quick check-ins - a key user need. Addresses pain-2-3 directly.
acceptance_criteria: Small widget shows top 3 habits with tap-to-complete
Medium widget shows up to 6 habits with completion status
Large widget shows all daily habits with category grouping
Widget updates reflect in app immediately
Works on both iOS and Android
user_stories: As a user, I want to mark habits complete from my home screen so I don't have to open the app
As a user, I want to see my habit progress at a glance on my home screen

features.title: Offline Mode with Sync
features.description: Enable full app functionality when offline. Queue changes locally and sync when connection is restored. Handle conflicts gracefully.
features.rationale: Habitica requires constant internet - a major pain point. Users need to track habits anywhere (subway, airplane, rural areas). Convex supports offline patterns.
acceptance_criteria: All read operations work offline with cached data
Habit completions can be recorded offline
Offline changes sync automatically when online
Clear indicator shows offline status
Conflict resolution prefers most recent change
No data loss when switching between online/offline
user_stories: As a commuter, I want to use the app underground so I can track habits anytime
As a traveler, I want to track habits without WiFi so my routine isn't interrupted

features.title: Advanced Recurring Patterns
features.description: Support complex habit schedules: every N days, specific days of month, X times per week (flexible), weekdays only, etc.
features.rationale: Current implementation likely supports basic daily/weekly. Users need flexibility for habits like 'workout 3x per week' or 'review finances on 1st and 15th'. Identified in known_gaps.
acceptance_criteria: Support 'every N days' scheduling (e.g., every 3 days)
Support 'X times per week, any day' flexibility
Support specific days of month (1st, 15th, last day)
Support weekday-only or weekend-only habits
Streak calculation adapts to schedule type
user_stories: As a gym-goer, I want to set '3 times per week' without specifying days so I have flexibility
As a user, I want habits for specific dates like 'pay rent on 1st' to appear only when relevant

features.title: Multiple Daily Completions
features.description: Allow habits to be completed multiple times per day with a target count. Track each completion with optional notes.
features.rationale: Habitify users complain they can't track 'brush teeth' 2x daily without creating duplicate habits. This is a common need for health habits (water, medication, meals).
acceptance_criteria: Users can set target completions per day (1-10)
Each completion is tracked separately with timestamp
Progress indicator shows X/Y completions
Habit is 'complete' when target is reached
Analytics show completion distribution throughout day
user_stories: As a user tracking water intake, I want to log each glass so I reach my daily goal
As a user, I want to track 'brush teeth' morning and night as one habit with 2 completions

features.title: Habit to Break (Negative Habits)
features.description: Support tracking habits to STOP doing, with different mechanics (success = not doing it). Show 'days since' instead of streak.
features.rationale: Loop only supports positive habits - users want to break bad habits too. Different visualization needed (days clean, not streak of doing something).
acceptance_criteria: Users can create 'break habit' type with different icon
Success = marking day as 'didn't do it'
Shows 'X days clean' counter instead of streak
Relapse tracking with notes (optional)
Encouragement messages adapted for breaking habits
user_stories: As a user trying to quit smoking, I want to track 'days smoke-free' so I see my progress
As a user, I want to track habits to break (social media, snacking) not just habits to build

features.title: Smart Notification Improvements
features.description: Enhance notifications to be adaptive based on user behavior: learn optimal times, reduce noise when habits are completed, smart batching.
features.rationale: Streaks users complain notifications aren't smart enough. Time-based suggestions chip (existing) is a differentiator - extend this intelligence to notifications.
acceptance_criteria: Learn from completion patterns to suggest optimal reminder times
Auto-dismiss notifications when habit is completed
Batch multiple habit reminders into single notification when appropriate
Respect focus/DND modes
User can override learned times
user_stories: As a user, I want reminders at times I'm likely to complete habits so they're helpful
As a user, I don't want notifications for habits I already completed today

features.title: Achievement Sharing
features.description: Generate shareable cards/images for milestones (7-day streak, 100 completions, etc.) that users can post to social media.
features.rationale: Organic growth through social sharing. Users are proud of achievements and want to share. Creates brand awareness through user-generated content.
acceptance_criteria: Auto-generate shareable image when milestone reached
Image includes cat character, achievement, and app branding
One-tap share to major platforms (Instagram, Twitter, etc.)
Multiple visual templates to choose from
Privacy option to hide specific habit names
user_stories: As a user who hit 30-day streak, I want to share this achievement so my friends see my progress
As a user, I want attractive shareable images so I'm proud to post them

features.title: Habit Templates Sharing
features.description: Allow users to share their habit setups as templates that others can import. Create a public template library.
features.rationale: Reduces setup friction for new users. Creates community engagement. Users often ask 'what habits should I track?' - templates answer this.
acceptance_criteria: Users can export habit configuration as shareable link
Recipients can preview template before importing
Import creates habits with user's own customization
Curated template library (Morning Routine, Fitness, Mindfulness, etc.)
User-submitted templates with moderation
user_stories: As a new user, I want to import a 'morning routine' template so I don't start from scratch
As an experienced user, I want to share my habit setup with friends starting their journey

features.title: Accountability Partners
features.description: Connect with friends to see each other's progress and provide encouragement. No competition/leaderboard - just mutual support.
features.rationale: Habitica shut down forums, reducing social accountability. Users want connection without competitive pressure. Gentle accountability matches cat theme personality.
acceptance_criteria: Users can invite friends via link or contact search
See friend's streak status (not detailed habits, privacy)
Send encouragement messages/reactions
Get notified when friend hits milestone
Easy to disconnect if needed
user_stories: As a user, I want to connect with my workout buddy so we motivate each other
As a user, I want to see my friend's progress so I feel accountable to continue

features.title: Group Challenges
features.description: Create time-limited group challenges (30-day meditation challenge) where friends participate together toward a common goal.
features.rationale: Group accountability drives engagement. Different from Habitica's complex party quests - simpler, time-bound challenges. Could be viral growth mechanism.
acceptance_criteria: Users can create challenges with defined duration and habit
Invite friends to join challenge via link
Group progress visualization (everyone's completion rate)
Celebration when group completes challenge
Templates for common challenges
user_stories: As a group of friends, we want to do a 30-day reading challenge together so we stay motivated
As a challenge creator, I want to see how everyone is progressing so I can encourage stragglers

features.title: Fair Monetization Model
features.description: Implement premium features with transparent pricing, easy cancellation, and generous free tier. Consider lifetime purchase option.
features.rationale: Fabulous has 1.0 stars on Trustpilot due to billing. Habitica's gem system frustrates users. Habitify's pricing is inconsistent. Be the trustworthy option in a sea of predatory pricing.
acceptance_criteria: Free tier includes core features (unlimited habits, basic analytics)
Premium adds: advanced analytics, unlimited templates, themes, priority support
Simple pricing: one price, all platforms
One-tap cancellation in app
Lifetime purchase option alongside subscription
No premium currency or confusing gem systems
user_stories: As a user, I want clear pricing so I know exactly what I'm paying for
As a user, I want to cancel easily if the app isn't for me, without calling support

features.title: Apple Watch & Wear OS Support
features.description: Create companion apps for Apple Watch and Wear OS that allow viewing habits and quick completion from the wrist.
features.rationale: Identified in known_gaps. Streaks has flaky Watch support, Habitify's Watch interface is buggy. Do it right or don't do it.
acceptance_criteria: View today's habits on watch
Complete habits with haptic confirmation
Complications show streak or progress
Sync with phone app reliably
Works offline on watch with later sync
user_stories: As a Watch user, I want to check off habits during workouts without my phone
As a user, I want a watch complication showing my daily progress at a glance

features.title: AI-Powered Habit Insights
features.description: Use AI (existing API keys available) to analyze habit patterns and provide personalized recommendations: best times, habit stacking suggestions, streak risk prediction.
features.rationale: Multiple AI API keys in project suggest AI features planned. Differentiate with smart insights that competitors don't offer. Leverage existing time-based suggestion infrastructure.
acceptance_criteria: Weekly AI-generated insight summary
Habit stacking recommendations based on completion patterns
Predict which habits are at risk of being dropped
Suggest optimal times based on completion history
Cat character delivers insights in personality-consistent way
user_stories: As a user, I want the app to tell me which habits I'm likely to skip so I can focus on them
As a user, I want suggestions for which habits to do together based on my patterns

features.title: AI Habit Coach
features.description: Conversational AI (chat with the cat) that helps users set goals, troubleshoot habit struggles, and provide personalized coaching.
features.rationale: Fabulous offers coaching but with terrible billing. Provide AI-powered coaching that's accessible and in-character with the cat theme. Multiple LLM API keys available.
acceptance_criteria: Chat interface with cat character
Context-aware: knows user's habits, streaks, patterns
Can help set SMART goals
Provides troubleshooting for struggling habits
Maintains cat personality throughout conversation
user_stories: As a user struggling with a habit, I want to chat with the cat for advice
As a new user, I want help figuring out which habits to track

features.title: Health App Integrations
features.description: Connect with Apple Health, Google Fit, and other health platforms to auto-complete habits based on tracked activities.
features.rationale: Habitify integrates with health apps. Reduces friction for fitness habits - if you did a workout logged in Apple Health, habit auto-completes.
acceptance_criteria: Apple Health integration for iOS
Google Fit integration for Android
Auto-complete habits based on health data (steps, workouts, sleep)
User controls which habits auto-complete
Manual override always available
user_stories: As a runner, I want my 'run 3x week' habit to auto-complete when Apple Health logs a run
As a user, I want my step goal habit to sync with my phone's step counter
